details: U.S. spot Bitcoin and Ethereum exchange-traded funds (ETFs) collectively attracted $2.6 billion in net inflows last week. This represents their most robust performance since October 2025 and a threefold increase in trading volume, effectively reversing a $392 million outflow from the preceding week.
title: Bitcoin & Ethereum ETFs See Strongest Inflows Since October

details: Zcash (ZEC) surged to an eight-year high, reaching nearly $850. The privacy-focused cryptocurrency also saw its futures trading volume approach $10 billion, largely propelled by Grayscale's ongoing efforts to launch a Zcash ETF.
title: Zcash Hits Eight-Year High Amid Grayscale ETF Push

details: Solana has successfully implemented a mainnet upgrade, cutting its target slot time from 400 milliseconds to 350 milliseconds. This is the initial phase of a broader strategy to further reduce the slot time to 200 milliseconds, aiming to enhance transaction confirmation speeds.
title: Solana Reduces Mainnet Slot Time for Faster Transactions

details: DeFi protocol Term Labs confirmed a governance exploit impacting its lending vaults, with blockchain security firms estimating losses of approximately $8.5 million in various cryptocurrencies. This incident underscores persistent security challenges within the decentralized finance sector.
title: Term Labs Suffers Estimated $8.5M Exploit

details: Shiba Inu (SHIB) has achieved a significant milestone in Japan, being included in an exclusive list of just six approved cryptocurrencies by Laser Digital Japan, the digital assets arm of a major Japanese investment holding company. This move signals growing institutional acceptance for SHIB in a highly regulated market.
title: Shiba Inu Gains Elite Status in Japanese Crypto Market
